page.title: Salvation (Roblox) Codes, Soul Trials & Beginner Guide
page.meta_description: Salvation is a free-to-play Tensura-inspired Roblox RPG with permadeath, Soul Trials, races and loot. See codes status, controls and beginner tips.
page.tagline: Reincarnate into a Tensura-inspired Roblox RPG where death sticks, Soul Trials test you, and every life is a new beginning.
overview: Salvation is an early-alpha Roblox RPG inspired by That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (Tensura). The Roblox page describes reincarnation as the start of your story, with an open world to explore, unique races to try, quests and combat to progress, bosses and dungeons to challenge, and loot to find. It also has permanent death: death has lasting consequences.

The game is free to play and supports Roblox on PC, Mac, mobile, tablet, Xbox, PlayStation, and VR. A video published Nov 7, 2026 says public playtesting is open; the store page still labels the game [EARLY ALPHA]. The server cap listed on Roblox is 20 players.

If you are looking for Salvation codes, the sources here do not list any active code strings. The in-game prompt shown in a Soul Trials video only says: “Enjoying Salvation? Make sure to Like / Thumbs up the game for more codes!” No code is provided in that prompt.

how_to_play: Start by reincarnating; your race and choices shape the life you play.
Use quests, combat, and exploration to progress and grow stronger.
Try different races to experience their possibilities and combat styles.
Master weapons, abilities, and fighting styles, then take on bosses and dungeons for valuable rewards.
Find equipment, weapons, and accessories; Soul Trials footage shows slots for head, shoulders, torso, legs, main hand, off hand, and lantern.
To attempt a Soul Trial, speak with the Purgatory Master and choose to face your shadows. You can practice first; practice losses cost nothing.
In the real trial, beat Shadow of [Player Name] within 5 minutes. If you fall too far, your soul passes on and you wipe.
Use M1, crit, parry, dash back, and Z skills in combat, and press C to interact with NPCs and objects.
tips: Use Practice Trials before the real Soul Trial; the video notes losing practice costs nothing.
If you can, reroll for Illusion Magic before the trial; its Z skill can force the shadow to teleport back to where it was a second earlier, setting up a crit.
Use the weapon-swap trick: equip Fist before talking to the Purgatory Master, then swap to your main weapon after the black fade-in. The shadow stays on Fist while you keep your real weapon.
Fight in short bursts: dash back, punish with a crit, add M1 hits, and parry when the shadow attacks.
Keep the 5-minute timer in mind. Don't drag the fight if you're close to failing the actual trial.
Because Salvation has permanent death, treat the actual Soul Trial as a risk; practice mode and preparation matter.
Challenge bosses and dungeons for valuable rewards, and check loot for equipment upgrades.
